track: The Inner Studio II - The Unfinished Works
voice_direction: mature male, warm, low, unhurried, near-monotone, intimate; speed ~0.85; let ellipses breathe

segments.text: This program is hypnotic in nature... and is created for relaxation, and personal growth. Never listen in a moving vehicle... or at any time when you need your full, awakened attention.

For if so many of your works... were begun with love... then quietly covered over... canvases turned toward the wall... pages closed mid-sentence... while the days gathered dust upon them... and something in you... stopped believing... you would ever return...
...then this is your time to sit, or lie back, more comfortably relaxed.
And you already know the way... through that tall studio door... as dusk settles once more over Paris... the room of white dust and quiet... waiting for you... as it always waits...
But tonight... your gaze drifts past the finished figures... to the far wall... where shapes rest under draped cloths... covered canvases... works paused... mid-becoming...
And you might notice... the cloths are not shrouds... only veils... and beneath them... the works have kept their forms... patient... unchanged... as if the years... were only an afternoon...
For nothing begun in love... ever truly abandons its maker... it simply waits... without resentment... for your hand... to return...
And as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you may notice the dust settling... slower... softer... the way evening light... rests upon the draped forms...
Somewhere... the distant murmur of the city... fading... fading... until only the studio breathes... and you breathe with it...
Deeper with every breath... sinking into the quiet... that the covered works have kept... all this time... for you...
For your inner, wiser self... never left this room... it has smoothed the veils... kept the chisels bright... awaiting... your return...
And here... in the quietest corner of your studio... the unfinished works... stand waiting... in the half-light...
Every project ever set aside... every canvas covered... every page paused... resting here... still yours...
And the work does not ask... where you have been...
It asks only... where shall we begin... today...
For a work set aside... is not a work lost... it is a work... still waiting...
You may find yourself lifting a cloth... gently... and the figure beneath... still warm... still willing...
And you might be pleasantly surprised... how the hand remembers... the stroke... the mind had forgotten...
The middle of a work... is only... a deeper beginning...
You need not start over... you need only... start again...
For completion is a quiet act... one true stroke... then another...
No fanfare... no witness... only you... the chisel... and the waiting stone...
And each cloth you lift... frees the light... that was always underneath...
Perhaps the waiting itself... has ripened the work... like marble... cured by seasons...
What you could not finish then... your hands now know... how to finish...
For time has been carving with you... even while you were away...
And the old hesitation... was only dust... upon a covered canvas... it brushes away... so easily...
One work at a time... one cloth... one stroke... one quiet evening... at a time...
For you have always been the finisher... and the works... have always believed it...
And somewhere... a covered canvas... knows your footsteps... and leans toward them...
And now... as the studio gently brightens... you can bring something back with you...
For the works you thought abandoned... were never behind you... only beneath their veils... keeping your place...
And when you pass an old project, from this day forward... you pause... you lift the cloth... and you look.
When the work calls you back... you answer.
When the middle feels heavy... you make one stroke... and trust it.
When a piece asks to be finished... you finish it... quietly... completely.
For you are... the finisher of your own works...
And the world... is waiting... for what only you can finish.
